prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: desktop pet animation sprite sheet. Reference image is the exact fawn clay pug character to preserve, warm tan fur, black muzzle and floppy dark ears, cute glossy eyes. Create an anatomically believable, continuous 8-frame WALK CYCLE, exactly 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, chronological left to right then next row. Strict right-facing side view with slight 3/4 visibility, camera and head/body size/position identical in every cell. Full quadruped body, four short legs. Slow relaxed four-beat walk, one lifted paw at a time, paws on ground travel BACKWARD relative to body then lift and swing forward, alternating near and far feet. 8 equally spaced phases of the same cycle, small paw travel, very subtle body bob. No sitting, no hopping, no jumping. All cells same scale and same floor baseline, character occupies central 80% of each square cell. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no ground shadow, no props, no text, no dividers, no symbols. Detailed handmade clay texture as reference. This is one consistent character walking, not eight different poses or viewpoints.
runtime: A fixed aligned pose is deformed with four separate paw trajectories. Feet travel backward during stance and lift forward during swing. Frames are indexed by distance travelled.
